description: Bounded ACP protocol transcript. The `initialize` exchange is derived from the real, non-model `cursor-agent acp` handshake observed live in RUN_046 (cursor-agent 2026.07.09-a3815c0), with sensitive/host-specific data removed. Everything past the handshake is spec-derived (Agent Client Protocol method names confirmed in the installed CLI's bundled source, but field layouts NOT yet confirmed live) and is labeled accordingly.
framing: newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio (one JSON object per line)

messages.note: The exact `initialize` request the RUN_046 handshake probe sent.
Well-formed JSON-RPC 2.0 response; id matched; ~1.1s round-trip. Capability values are the real ones observed (no host/account data).
`session/new` method name confirmed in bundled source; param layout is from the Agent Client Protocol spec, NOT confirmed live.
Expected `session/new` result shape (sessionId). Field name not confirmed live.
`session/prompt` with a client-assigned unique request id (string). The prompt text is the governed Admissible instruction.
Progress notification. Admissible accumulates `agent_message_chunk` text into the canonical response and stores only a bounded summary for every other update kind (never raw token/thought streams).
Terminal result for the prompt request id. Admissible treats the first terminal for a request id as authoritative and ignores replays (exactly-once).
Targeted cancellation (sent on idle/absolute timeout before the managed process tree is terminated). Method name confirmed in bundled source.

unknowns: Exact `session/new` / `session/prompt` request+result field layouts (only `initialize` confirmed live).
Whether `session/prompt` returns a distinct acceptance ack before progress, or acceptance is implicit in the first `session/update`.
Whether `session/cancel` is a request (expects a response) or a notification.
Auth (`cursor_login`) semantics for a headless server beyond the bare handshake.
Behavior/removal risk of the hidden `acp` command across future CLI versions.
